prompt: Use case: pixel VFX sprite sheet for an Octopath-style forest HD-2D RPG. Strict FOUR ROWS x FOUR COLUMNS of square equal-size cells, 16 frames total. Each row is a distinct small effect with four looping phases from LEFT to RIGHT. Row1: tiny amber firefly, body at fixed center, four clear wing-flutter phases, bright small abdomen, NO external halo. Row2: ONE ochre fallen leaf fluttering through four rotations about same central pivot, no extra leaves. Row3: THREE tiny cream-gold spore motes moving subtly around fixed center through four phases, hard-edged small pixels, no clouds. Row4: one narrow diagonal sunlight-mask ribbon in four subtle width/intensity phases, hard 2-tone ivory/pale ochre pixel steps, no atmospheric haze. Keep each frame wholly inside central55% of its cell with large pure magenta gaps on all sides, no trail crosses a cell line. Four frames same logical canvas and anchor per row; first/last phases join naturally. Original forest source determines palette, foliage shape and biome; pet sheets show pixel edges only. Restrained natural colors, crisp square pixel clusters, no vector gradients. Background EXACT pure flat #FF00FF, no white glow painted into background, no smoke or fog, no ground or scene. No text, labels, separator lines or numbers. These are small additive-friendly source sprites; ENGINE adds bloom and volumetric presentation.
source_card: Four forest small effects required by art brief: firefly, leaf, spores and sunlight mask. Original forest colors/material identity; pixel loops, not character animation.
